description: Impulsberatung erneuerbar heizen: EFH und MFH bis 6 Wohneinheiten is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Energie BFE. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
